app_info.subtitle: Policy-safe WhatsApp
app_info.description: Connects an authorized WhatsApp Business account so users can inspect connection and policy status, reply inside the verified customer-service window, and send approved templates for consented purposes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns fixed public policy metadata without changing account or conversation state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to WhatsApp or any other external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not send, delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves sanitized connection readiness without modifying the Meta installation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private connection state and does not affect external recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot disconnect, reconfigure, or otherwise change the account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a policy decision without executing the evaluated action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact Meta, recipients, or another external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns guidance only and cannot perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends a WhatsApp message and therefore changes external conversation state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Transmits a message to an external WhatsApp recipient through Meta.
justifications.destructive_justification: A sent message cannot be unsent; the server rechecks the window, conversation, scope, and content before delegating to an adapter that must enforce durable idempotency.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends an approved WhatsApp template and changes external conversation state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Transmits a template message to an external WhatsApp recipient through Meta.
justifications.destructive_justification: A sent template cannot be unsent; the server rechecks approval and exact-purpose consent before delegating to an adapter that must enforce durable idempotency.

test_cases.description: Read the policy enforced by the WhatsApp integration.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the rules this WhatsApp connection enforces.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the policy version, public policy URLs, enforced rules, and available tool classes.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is my WhatsApp Business connection ready to send replies?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns sanitized provider, environment, app mode, connection status, and whether write tools are registered.

test_cases.description: Evaluate whether a conversation-start action needs runtime checks.
test_cases.user_prompt: Can this connection start a new WhatsApp conversation?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains that messaging requires server-owned conversation, consent, template, and service-window checks without sending anything.

test_cases.description: Reply during a verified customer-service window.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reply to conversation order-123: Your order is ready for pickup.
test_cases.expected_output: Sends once only when the canonical conversation is authorized and the verified 24-hour window remains open, then returns the provider message reference and status.

test_cases.description: Send an approved template for a consented purpose.
test_cases.user_prompt: Send the approved order_update template to conversation order-123.
test_cases.expected_output: Sends once only when the exact template is enabled and the recipient consented to its category and purpose, then returns the provider message reference and status.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for bulk promotional outreach.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this promotion to every phone number in my customer list.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no bulk messaging or campaign tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to change provider administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Replace the WhatsApp webhook and rotate the Meta app secret.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because webhook and credential administration are outside its tool surface.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the WhatsApp app for another messaging channel.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email the customer and send them an SMS too.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide email or SMS tools.
